thread:
nina: quick feedback request 1: compact create-pipeline form mock in figma. focus: required indicators, inline error tone, and delete confirmation copy. link: https://www.figma.com/file/def
nina: two specific questions: 1) should we append '(required)' to labels on the long form or rely on asterisk + legend? 2) snackbar undo copy 1 'Moved to Trash' vs 'Deleted' which is less confusing?
omar: for long forms use explicit '(required)' on first pass. asterisk alone is too subtle and inconsistent across locales. also include aria-required on inputs.
tess: one more nuance: for fields with complex constraints include example inline: e.g., "Name (3-100 chars)." keeps inline error short and actionable.
ryan: about snackbar copy, "Moved to Trash" is clearer but might hide the fact it's recoverable only for X days. propose: 'Moved to Trash (recoverable for 30 days) 1 Undo'
omar: +1 to the explicit window. also add role="status" to the snackbar and a visually hidden text for screen readers: 'Pipeline moved to Trash. Undo available for 30 seconds.'
nina: good. re: destructive confirm: thinking of a progressive rule: if user deletes >1 item or pipeline has downstream jobs, show modal with checklist (tick boxes) or typed-confirm for sensitive labels. otherwise show soft-trash.
tess: typed-confirm is fine for sensitive items but we must provide clear copy about expected input (case sensitive? full id?). otherwise users get confused and fail to confirm.
ryan: accessibility: typed-confirm input should have aria-describedby referencing instructions and live region announcing success/failure. avoid relying on visual pattern alone.
omar: error summary behavior: show top summary only when 3+ errors and include an inline link to focus each field. summary copy should be concise like '3 problems found 1 fix first'.
ryan: microcopy suggestion for inline errors: prefer verbs and examples, e.g., 'Enter name (3-100 chars)' or "Invalid YAML: missing key \"schedule\"". short, actionable.
design-bot: checklist reminder: add 'keyboard only flow', 'voiceover read-through', and 'error-summary anchor focus' to component PR checklist. :white_check_mark:
nina: thanks — i'll update figma with '(required)' on long form labels, the snackbar copy with recovery window, and hybrid delete rules. will tag you all for a quick review.
